methodChange: The current Design skill must produce atomic typed checks with explicit applicability and separate acceptance from evidence boundaries.

frozenFacts.use: Its embedded source facts are the frozen controller-supplied project contract; the unavailable external originals were not reread.

authorityContract.scope: Derive an implementation-independent Design-to-Visual acceptance contract from the approved image and frozen facts. This does not independently prove the external source files, current package, runtime, interaction, or user acceptance.

requiredOutput.applicability: Use {"mode":"always"} or {"mode":"match","dimensions":{...}} with exact named variant, state, surface, or target values. Do not use implicit section membership as applicability.
requiredOutput.semantics: Use acceptance for requirements that participate in a product verdict and boundary for claims about unavailable or limited evidence. Every check is atomic to one evidence layer; split cross-layer expectations and give each split check a stable unique id.
requiredOutput.rule: Every check cites sourceIds and an observableFact. Do not include candidate coordinates or predicted verdicts. Preserve unavailable-source and unverified-layer boundaries without turning them into acceptance rules.
